questions.question: 1. What is the first step in preparing a transverse section of a leaf for microscopic observation?

answers.c: Cutting a thin slice using a new razor blade

questions.question: 2. In the procedure of a stem transverse section, which stain is used to distinguish xylem?
3. What is the purpose of placing the prepared stem transverse section in water during the experiment?

answers.a: To soften the tissue for slicing
answers.b: To keep the section hydrated during observation

questions.question: 4. After mounting a stained transverse section of a root, what is the correct sequence of objective lenses for observation?

answers.a: High power -> Medium power -> Low power
answers.b: Medium power -> Low power -> High power
answers.c: Low power -> Medium power -> High power
answers.d: Low power -> High power -> Medium power

questions.question: 5. While observing a transverse section of a dicot root, a student notices that the epidermal cells appear crushed and the edges are ragged, kaing it impossible to see individual cell boundaries. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this error?

answers.a: The student used a high-power objective first
answers.b: The student used a dull razor blade to cut the section
answers.c: The section was left in Fast Green for too long
answers.d: The specimen was not stained with Safranin
